fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOGL)'s Q3 Google Cloud revenue more than doubled to $30.7 billion, yet over $280 billion of market cap was wiped out among the $5.3 trillion total as stock price fell 11%
fields.summary_ko.1: Google Search revenue reached $63.4 billion with 12% growth but fell short of market expectations of 15% or less, and concerns that AI could encroach on search business are a major factor intensifying investor selling
fields.summary_ko.2: Q3 total revenue was $127.6 billion (25% increase year-over-year), but capital expenditures increased to $51.4 billion, more than double the prior-year $24 billion, with 2026 capex projected at $200 billion and 2027 at $300 billion
